about: The Ninth Howl's world variables (Docs/Design/86 10.1 step 2; artifacts/quests/design/campaign.md 4 and 2.11). The DM declares every one before nh-purses and Act I are approved: tools/nh_world_vars.py --apply, or by hand in Campaigns > World variables (a type, the first value, the note). Every story that uses one declares it with the same name and type.
